title: Extradition fight and 'we want to see him fry' embassy meeting

tellings.quote: Ed Gibson, who was a tache to the US embassy in London at the time, met with my lawyer and he said, "We want to see him fry." Electric chair reference.

plain: While Britain was deciding in the 2000s whether to send him to the United States for trial, Gary McKinnon, a hacker who says he found signs of a secret NASA space program, says an attaché at the US embassy in London, Ed Gibson, met his lawyer and said, "We want to see him fry." McKinnon takes it as a reference to the electric chair. He tells it to show how harshly he says the US wanted to punish him.
